name: omacom/omarchy
title: Omarchy agents panel adds automatic switching between Claude, Codex and Grok accounts near a usage limit
summary: Omarchy's agent tooling can register a second Claude account and switch new sessions to the account with the most room left once usage reaches a set threshold (90% in the example), keeping the current session running. It works for Codex and Grok as well, and the README is in the repo.
